type: C4 System
title: APM CLI
status: stable
groma:
  id: apm-cli
  technology: Pinned external CLI
---

An optional separately provisioned APM 0.39.0 distribution supplied with an explicit absolute executable path, entry SHA-256 and full companion-distribution digest. WPM requests lock, install and compile as distinct authoring actions using private native state. Connection configuration is projected by WPM with runtime credential references; plain setup never requires this external tool.
